items.title: A $300,000 Portfolio in NNN REIT, Vail Resorts and UPS Pays $17,814 a Year in Dividends. Here’s What Happens if One Cuts
items.summary: Key TakeawaysA $300,000 portfolio split evenly across NNN REIT, Vail Resorts and UPS pays about $17,800 a year in dividends, or about $1,480 a month, at today’s prices. NNN REIT’s dividend looks the safest of the three, taking 69% of its AFFO in fiscal 2025 after 37 straight years of raises.

items.title: 3 Logistics Stocks With Lower Fuel Costs Supporting Margins

That combination can reshape cost structures and sentiment, creating openings for investors who move before the story feels obvious. This article unpacks the fuel and inflation shock, then walks through 3 stocks exposed to this shift and what that could mean for your portfolio decisions. items.title: A 67-Year-Old With $500,000 in UPS, Altria and Omega Healthcare Collects $2,448 a Month in Dividends. How Safe Is Each Check?
items.summary: Key TakeawaysA 67-year-old with $500,000 split evenly across UPS, Altria and Omega Healthcare Investors collects about $29,400 a year in dividends at today’s prices, or about $2,450 a month. Altria’s dividend took 78% of free cash flow over the trailing-12 months, and the company targets mid-single-digit dividend growth each year through 2028.
